title: Coherent comparisons on the coefficient diagram
statement: In the geometric and coefficient setting of [lem-pod-lisse-coefficient-fiber-endomorphisms], suppose a natural comparison J_E≅P(E→L) followed by J_L is supplied for each coefficient inclusion. Then comparisons can be chosen to satisfy the unit and composition laws of the actual recorded pseudofunctor P. A rational scalar comparison of [lem-pod-lisse-rational-scalar-fiber-comparison] transports through the diagram category equalities and arrow equality to supply the required initial comparison.

proof.text: Transport a supplied rational comparison through the category equalities of the coefficient diagram. Its map_eq identifies the scalar-extension arrow; the two inverse category transports cancel, giving a comparison for the recorded diagram arrow.
Use the least finite coefficient field and the bijection on endomorphisms induced by its transition to every field.
Apply coherence normalization to the supplied comparisons and those bijections. This proves both equations for P actual constraints, without assuming a formula for them.

theorem lisseCoefficientFiberComparisons_exists
    (S : ∀ E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K,
      LisseRationalSheaf l E₀.val Y ⥤ ModuleCat.{d + 1} E₀.val)
    (hS : ∀ (E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K)
      (F : LisseRationalSheaf l E₀.val Y), (S E₀).obj F = lisseRationalFiber l E₀.val Y y F)
    (hmap : ∀ E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K,
      IsLisseRationalFiberFunctor Y y l E₀.val (S E₀) (hS E₀))
    (hcomparison :
      let P := (lisseCoefficientDiagramData l Y K).diagram
      let J := fun E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K ↦
        (eqToHom ((lisseCoefficientDiagramData l Y K).obj_eq E₀)).toFunctor ⋙
          S E₀ ⋙ ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap E₀.val K)
      ∀ (E₀ L₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K) (f : E₀ ⟶ L₀),
        J E₀ ≅ (P.map f.toLoc).toFunctor ⋙ J L₀) :
    let P := (lisseCoefficientDiagramData l Y K).diagram
    let J := fun E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K ↦
      (eqToHom ((lisseCoefficientDiagramData l Y K).obj_eq E₀)).toFunctor ⋙
        S E₀ ⋙ ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap E₀.val K)
    ∃ e : ∀ {E₀ L₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K} (f : E₀ ⟶ L₀),
        J E₀ ≅ (P.map f.toLoc).toFunctor ⋙ J L₀,
      (∀ (E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K) (X : P.obj ⟨E₀⟩),
        (e (𝟙 E₀)).hom.app X ≫
          (J E₀).map ((P.mapId ⟨E₀⟩).hom.toNatTrans.app X) = 𝟙 _) ∧
      (∀ {E₀ L₀ M₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K}
        (f : E₀ ⟶ L₀) (g : L₀ ⟶ M₀) (X : P.obj ⟨E₀⟩),
        (e (f ≫ g)).hom.app X ≫
            (J M₀).map ((P.mapComp f.toLoc g.toLoc).hom.toNatTrans.app X) =
          (e f).hom.app X ≫ (e g).hom.app ((P.map f.toLoc).toFunctor.obj X))
